name: Tetsuha Shoujo Blazer Special Edition ~Henshin Heroine Kankin Choukyou Mini AVG~
original_name: 鉄刃少女ブレイザー特別編~変身ヒロイン監禁調教ミニAVG~
source:
This is a short new visual novel about the pink-haired heroine's defeat assault and sexual reconstitution.
Fans of Metal Edge already know, Blazer has seen her share of sticky situations. But this time...

Out of the blue appears a scientist by the name of Professor Seishin.
Capturing Metal Edge Girl Blazer for what can only be nefarious purposes, he puts her through a rigorous program of destability.
Blazer's body changes! Her mind unravels! How will she escape this one? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE157381.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一部篇幅很短的新视觉小说，讲述粉红头发的女主角遭到击败、侵犯并接受性改造的故事。

《Metal Edge》的粉丝都知道，布莱泽已经经历过不少棘手场面。但这一次……

一名名叫精司教授的科学家突然出现。
他出于不怀好意的目的捕获了Metal Edge少女布莱泽，并让她接受严酷的失稳实验。
布莱泽的身体发生变化！她的心智逐渐崩溃！她要怎样逃离这一切？
